title: Numerical Analysis for a Nonlinear Coupled Thermoelastic System with Acoustic Boundary Conditions
summary: This paper presents the first $L^2$-norm error analysis for a nonlinear thermoelastic system with acoustic boundary conditions. The model involves three coupled variables: the acoustic potential $u$, the temperature $θ$, and the normal displacement to the boundary $δ$, with nonlinearities $|u|^d u$ in the domain and $g(\cdot,u')$ on the boundary, in addition to a nonlocal term $β(\int_Ωθdx)Δθ$ in the heat equation. We establish error estimates for the fully discrete problem, using the Crank-Nicolson method for time discretization and finite element method with basis of degree $r \geqslant 1$…
